name: A Nairobi compound

place_source.title: Wikidata: Nairobi (Q3870), coordinate location and elevation above sea level

blurb: A walled compound garden in Nairobi: jacaranda and mango over a lawn visited by hadada ibis, pied crows hunting on the grass, sunbirds and bulbuls in the guava and frangipani, vervet troops passing through the fever trees, and guttural toads calling from the garden pond after the rains.

facts.text: Nairobi has a subtropical highland climate (Köppen Cwb).
